description.zh: 本次2D形象生成任务成功或失败是否需要事件回调，默认false不回调。具体可参考文档：[数字人回调事件通知](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)。
description.en: Specifies whether to receive event callbacks for the success or failure of this 2D avatar generation task. The default value is false, which means no callbacks are sent. For more information, see [Digital Human Callback Notifications](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU).

description.zh:
人物缩略图。

- 如果不传，将会截取视频第一帧作为人物缩略图。
- 如果传，要求分辨率和原视频分辨率保持一致，格式png，大小<10M。
description.en:
The character thumbnail.

- If you do not provide a thumbnail, the first frame of the video is used as the thumbnail.

- If you provide a thumbnail, its resolution must match the source video. The image must be in PNG format and smaller than 10 MB.

description.zh:
原始视频方向：横竖屏

- 1: 竖屏
- 2: 横屏
description.en:
The orientation of the source video.

- 1: Portrait

- 2: Landscape

description.zh:
人物头像。不传不更新

-要求：尺寸1:1，格式png，大小<10M
description.en:
The character's profile picture. If you do not provide a profile picture, the existing one is not updated.

\- Requirements: 1:1 aspect ratio, PNG format, and a size smaller than 10 MB.

description.zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台的对应业务配置的开发者信息中获取的TenantId
description.en: The tenant ID. Get this ID from the developer information section of your business configuration on the Digitized Virtual Human Open Platform.

description.zh:
原始视频素材是否是透明

- true = 是透明格式，未来可支持替换背景
- false = 不是透明格式，不支持替换背景
description.en:
Specifies whether the source video has a transparent background.

- true: The video has a transparent background. The background can be replaced in the future.

- false: The video does not have a transparent background. The background cannot be replaced.

description.zh:
原始视频素材地址。只有创建失败的角色允许更新。要求：
- 格式mov、webm、mp4
- 视频时长3-8分钟
- 分辨率1080p
- 大小<10G
description.en:
The URL of the source video material. You can only update the video for roles that failed to be created. Requirements:

- Format: MOV, WebM, or MP4

- Duration: 3 to 8 minutes

- Resolution: 1080p

- Size: smaller than 10 GB

title.zh: 更新2D自定义形象创建任务
